checks.observed: Fresh app tab renders Settings and existing privacy/portable-data controls after rebuilt app startup.

coverage: Atomic candidate snapshots and compare/exchange contract
Stable command payload IDs, replay receipts and changed-payload rejection
Whitelisted input, canonical revisions and cross-runtime UTF-8 hashes
Todo/Daily completion and bounded ordered Habit events
Per-task ordering, profile repair and quota cooldown
Lease ownership, expired undispatched work and unknown dispatched effects
Unknown acceptance after lost storage acknowledgement; original command ID recovers receipt
Append-only typed transition evidence and corrupt-journal rejection
operation_notes: Local app server cleanup deadline produced a prerequisite interruption; server restart and a fresh browser tab restored validation. No application failure was inferred from the expired server.
limitations: Concrete durable browser storage and remote service adapters remain separate required dependencies.
Core tests use a synthetic atomic store and make no upstream calls.
PWA canonical command controls remain unintegrated.
